title: Inserting linked person and insurance rows
description: You can match explicit column lists with their supplied values.

steps.description: The first INSERT supplies person_id, first_name and last_name. You place John Doe under person_id 1.
The second INSERT targets Insurance with five named columns. Its person_id column connects the insurance row to a person.

steps.question: Which supplied value identifies the person associated with this insurance row?
steps.answer: The second value, 1, fills person_id and matches the person inserted first.

steps.description: You supply Provider A and explicit start and end dates for that row. The trace visits both inserts and shows no printed rows because the block contains no SELECT.
